title: Goblin post follow-up: making the 4 playable orcs — horn auditions, a shaman with dead eyes, a thief on a white background, and a pink phase
author: Joeykiwis
selftext:
People asked about the player characters after the goblin post. Same anchor, so my heroes and my goblins are literally cousins. But the heroes were way messier to make. In order of disaster:

**Act 1 — the warrior.** Orcs have horns, right? Four horn tries. The ram horns made him look like a fantasy goat. No horns won. Then twelve haircuts. Twelve.

https://preview.redd.it/6yligx1tawgh1.png?width=759&format=png&auto=webp&s=b0ff0fbc904652e2c522bd2d610b6a7b740d2351

**Act 2 — the shaman.** This one was face surgery all the way down. "Make him look older" aged the whole body. "Make the face cuter" worked way too well. One pass came back with completely dead eyes — see for yourself. What finally worked was the smallest possible edit: "fix ONLY the eyes."

https://preview.redd.it/o85x50huawgh1.png?width=766&format=png&auto=webp&s=cb5e066cbe1dbc042d3cf4a4fdcafffb47fabf25

  
**Act 3 — the thief.** She came back on a solid white background once, for no reason I ever figured out. And the female heroes went through what I can only call a pink phase — every edit drifted the skin pinker until I gave up and recolored her back to green in one dedicated pass.

https://preview.redd.it/rhorttwxawgh1.png?width=861&format=png&auto=webp&s=cabb32d3b6185ee58d5b9a50505a8fb8a535016f

Anyway. Something like 40 edits on one pudgy orc later, here are all four with their attack animations (animation is template-based on the tool side — pick from a library, no motion prompting):

https://i.redd.it/7pja4c2zawgh1.gif

Same disclosure as always: AI-generated (PixelLab), hand-curated, receipts on request.
